finish.summary: Built 4 bases as two pairs (-1,0/-1,1 and 0,0/1,0). Each pair internally joined by side-connector, and the two pairs linked by a side-connector between -1,0 and 0,0. No direct base adjacency beyond connectors. House rules capOpenFaces and lockJoints applied; meshes clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
